A '''language''' was used by the [[Storm-hair]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> several members of the species, including the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and his [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|followers]], the Chosen, spoke the [[Language/Legends|language]] during a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] against the [[Empire of the Hand]] on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]. Shortly after the warlord spoke the tongue into his [[Comm unit/Legends|communications device]], [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding]] the Chosen to attack the Imperial forces, the Storm-hairs were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. The [[Quesoth]] [[Trevik]] considered the language incomprehensible.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The language appeared in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and included in ''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]]'' of Zahn's [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
